name: Beam
description: One straight-sided beam, widening as it crosses the cell.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from @pick(20deg, 50deg, 80deg, 110deg, 140deg) at 0% 50%, #000 0 22deg, transparent 22deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from @pick(20deg, 50deg, 80deg, 110deg, 140deg) at 0% 50%, #000 0 22deg, transparent 22deg 360deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
